The total consumption of  cooling water in the cooling system of  steam turbine condensers and auxiliary equipment of  the Facility, according to the considered options, is 56,000.0 m 3 /h. To cool the circulating water, you will need:
- -evaporative  cooling  towers  with  an  irrigation  area  of 3x2100  m 2 , while  the  frequency  of irrigation in the condensing mode will be 8.9 m 3 /m 2 ·hour;
- circulation pumping station with a capacity of  56,000.0 m 3 /h with a switching chamber and a suction chamber;
- circulation conduits with a diameter of  1600+  2400 mm made of  steel pipes with stiffening rings. To  recharge  the  circulating system, water will be  required in  the  amount of 1100.0  m 3 /hour, 7700.0 thousand m 3 /year.
An evaporation field of  about 150 ha will be required to utilize the circulatory system blowdown water.
Taking into account the shortage of water resources in the region under consideration, a dry condenser was considered for cooling the installed equipment. When installing a dry condenser, water is not required to feed the cooling system.
